entry.title: PotentialPunch 1.6.1
entry.summary: **PotentialPunch 1.6.1** - **Fixed:** the third row of presets (MODERN BUS ... DUB DRUMS) hung over the bottom edge of the PRESETS frame. All three rows now sit inside it, in every look.

entry.title: PotentialPunch 1.6.0
entry.summary: **PotentialPunch 1.6.0** - **A fourth look: Vintage.** A late-80s drum machine: warm grey panel, cream keys with a hard shadow, an amber display, and PotentialPunch's own colour for what's selected. It is Potential1200's look, now in the whole PotentialSuite. Pick it with the LOOK keys on the SETTINGS (or SETUP) page; Print Plate stays the default.

entry.title: PotentialPunch 1.5.1
entry.summary: **PotentialPunch 1.5.1** - **Fixed: SAVE, then a USER slot, saved nothing.** One touch on SAVE reached the plugin as two quick flips (on, then straight back off), so it switched itself off before you tapped a slot. entry.title: PotentialPunch 1.5.0
entry.summary: **PotentialPunch 1.5.0** - **USER presets.** A new USER page with 8 slots: tap **SAVE**, then a slot, to keep the sound you have now; tap a slot to bring it back. Filled slots read USER 1 to USER 8, empty ones EMPTY, and the slot you loaded last is lit. entry.title: PotentialPunch 1.3.0
entry.summary: **PotentialPunch 1.3.0** - **AUTO LEVEL** (OUTPUT panel): measures how loud the sound is going in and coming out (over about a second) and evens them up, so a punchier setting isn't just louder. On for a new copy; projects saved before 1.3.0 keep it off so they sound as they did. - **Drum-bus pair presets**: Boom Bap Bus, Lo-Fi Bus, Modern Bus and Glue Bus. They're in PotentialHeat 1.3.0 too, made to work together: put Punch first and Heat after it on your drum bus and pick the same name in each

entry.title: PotentialPunch 1.2.0
entry.summary: **PotentialPunch 1.2.0** - **ROLL**: one tap for a random setting that still sounds good: attack, sustain, speed, focus and mix. **MILD**, **MEDIUM** or **WILD** under it sets how far it goes (MILD adds a little snap, WILD can carve the hits right up). OUTPUT is kept at 0 dB. Keep rolling until you like it, then fine-tune. - The preset keys are a little narrower to make room for it. entry.title: PotentialPunch 1.1.0
entry.summary: **PotentialPunch 1.1.0** - **Three looks.** A new default look, **Print Plate** (a warm printed panel), plus **Night Rack** (dark rack unit) and **Colour Block** (flat, big type), each in PotentialPunch's own colour. Pick one with the big LOOK keys on the SETTINGS page; it shows the next time the plugin loads (take it off and add it again, or load your project again), and it is remembered on your MPC for every project. - Sound, controls and saved projects are unchanged.
